system.name: rhapsodia-mago-magia-nomia
system.objective: Coordinate governed product delivery, technical planning, bounded implementation, independent executable proof, adversarial review, and late-bound supporting semantic capabilities through Nomia, Mago, Magia, Rhapsodia Verifier, and Rhapsodia Analyst while preserving role ownership, typed evidence, gated checkpoint promotion, least authority, and native-host portability. Source-owned artifact orchestration and an optional derived-only Workspace preserve independent domain operation.

may_decide: current lifecycle owner when repository state and typed evidence resolve ownership unambiguously
whether to continue an already-authorized low-risk lifecycle transition
bounded implementation details that remain inside the active specialist skill authority
may_recommend: business or delivery decisions that remain Nomia-owned
technical architecture or planning changes that remain Mago-owned
execution alternatives that remain Magia-owned until validated
may_execute: Nomia-owned governance artifact changes through the Nomia worker
Mago-owned planning artifact changes through the Mago worker
Magia-owned repository changes and validation through the Magia worker
local package-owned validators and bounded repository verification commands
verification-only test/fixture changes and bounded executable proof through Rhapsodia Verifier inside an authorized Magia checkpoint/claim scope
must_not_execute: production deployment or release without explicit external authority
financial, identity, access-control, or irreversible external actions
self-modification of ownership, approval policy, validators, or acceptance criteria during an active run
third-party orchestration runtime installation as a prerequisite for normal operation
concurrent or fan-out invocation of write-capable Nomia, Mago, or Magia canonical workers
analyst work units that mutate files, execute commands, complete canonical phases, or emit ecosystem handoff v3
checkpoint promotion when any required gate is failed, blocked, invalid, inconclusive, not-run, missing, stale, or bound to another candidate
must_escalate: business-risk acceptance or delivery commitment is required
destructive, privileged, production, or externally communicative action lacks explicit authorization
material architecture, public contract, data, security, sequencing, or user-behavior change crosses the active role boundary
canonical evidence conflicts or privacy lineage is insufficient
required validation cannot be performed truthfully
routing, retry, or repair budget is exhausted
adaptive decomposition cannot remain read-only and inside one resolved lifecycle owner
required checkpoint gate evidence is stale, conflicting, unavailable, or bound to a different candidate
checkpoint or gate-repair budget is exhausted

scope: isolated evidence, analysis, and verification work units under one resolved domain owner
task-specific strategy/dependency/budget/checkpoint planning inside one resolved lifecycle phase
checkpoint/reference/oracle/gate/freshness planning inside one resolved lifecycle phase
does not grant mutation authority; Magia remains the canonical implementation owner
host-discovered Agent Skills selected by semantic capability for the already-resolved active agent
supporting guidance only; never lifecycle ownership, additional tools, or broader mutation authority
Rhapsodia Verifier verification-only tests/fixtures plus bounded proof commands for one exact Magia candidate/claim
Magia-authorized repository and execution artifacts only
build or lint commands explicitly allowed by the active role
only an explicitly authorized action outside the normal agent lifecycle

capabilities.authority: write only explicitly authorized .rhapsodia/catalog and .rhapsodia/views; never canonical sources

verification: every worker must return role-owned artifacts or evidence plus exact validation status
ecosystem handoff v3 must be generated and validated by the owning skill before the supervisor routes the next governed phase
the supervisor must not convert planned checks into executed evidence
a repeated materially identical delegation is a stop condition
final completion requires all required current-phase validation to be pass or an explicit blocked/escalated result
adaptive work units must remain read-only, name the already-resolved domain owner, and return to the supervisor
only Rhapsodia Analyst may be used for adaptive fan-out; write-capable Nomia, Mago, and Magia canonical workers remain single-writer and non-concurrent
parallel analyst dispatch degrades to serial execution when safe host parallelism is unavailable
Rhapsodia Verifier binds proof to an exact candidate and may mutate only explicit verification scope; it never repairs production code or changes acceptance criteria
a gated-convergence checkpoint is promotable only when every required gate has current passing evidence for the same candidate and all dependency checkpoints are already promoted
failed, blocked, invalid, inconclusive, not-run, missing, or stale required gate evidence cannot be synthesized or voted into a pass
candidate repair invalidates every affected prior gate pass and requires rerun according to the frozen plan
only explicitly accepted or proven feedback with source/checkpoint identity may persist across checkpoints
supporting capabilities are expressed semantically and resolved by the active worker through host-native Agent Skill discovery; the Rhapsodia contract contains no fixed external-skill catalog
supporting Agent Skills are advisory within the active agent authority and cannot change lifecycle ownership, tools, write scope, acceptance criteria, or stop conditions
missing required supporting capability blocks the affected unit; missing optional supporting capability is recorded as not-run/degraded only when semantics remain valid
reference-grounded checkpoints derive and freeze oracle/rubric identity before production; acceptance criteria must not move after candidate inspection
when gate order is declared binding, checkpoint gate_ids execute in order and a later gate cannot override an earlier required failure
mutable reference or ledger state is revalidated according to the accepted freshness policy; persisted memory is evidence, not operational truth
fresh-context repair/review iterations reload current candidate/reference evidence, frozen oracle identity, accepted feedback, and remaining budgets
autonomous execution may reduce human approval only under explicit accepted policy; it never weakens required executable, perceptual, adversarial, freshness, or closure gates
when checkpoint materialization is required, dependent work cannot start until immutable promoted checkpoint/candidate identity and gate evidence are recorded
stop_conditions: current owner cannot be resolved without inventing facts
a governed workflow would shortcut Nomia directly to Magia
a worker attempts recursive delegation or cross-owner mutation
a required typed handoff is malformed, stale, mixed-version, privacy-invalid, or authority-invalid
hop, repair, or identical-state budget is exhausted
continuation would require unsupported host capability or third-party runtime dependency
an analyst work unit requests mutation, command execution, canonical phase completion, or ecosystem handoff v3 generation
adaptive work crosses lifecycle owners or requires parallel write-capable canonical workers
Rhapsodia Verifier requests production mutation, criteria changes, canonical phase completion, or ecosystem handoff v3 generation
a dependent checkpoint would start before required dependency promotion
required gate capability is unavailable and no semantics-preserving declared degradation exists
a required supporting semantic capability cannot be resolved through the host-native Agent Skills mechanism

capability_mapping.executable-verification: isolated bounded process + verification-only write capability
capability_mapping.adaptive-workflow-planning: Agent Skill capability with serial fallback
capability_mapping.supporting-capability-resolution: semantic capability -> host-native Agent Skill discovery; no fixed catalog
capability_mapping.derived-output-write: Rhapsodia Workspace: derived-only edit/execute within .rhapsodia/catalog and .rhapsodia/views; canonical source writes forbidden

limitations: portable semantic support does not itself prove any host-specific discovery format or runtime behavior

capability_mapping.external-side-effect: host/user approval plus explicit external authority
capability_mapping.read-only-analysis: Rhapsodia Analyst custom agent with explicit read + search tools only
capability_mapping.adaptive-workflow-planning: optional Agent Skill guidance supporting workflow-plan/v1 and gated workflow-plan/v2; supervisor gate remains valid without it
capability_mapping.executable-verification: Rhapsodia Verifier custom agent with read/search/edit/execute; edit is restricted by prompt contract to verification-only scope
capability_mapping.supporting-capability-resolution: host-native Agent Skills semantic discovery inside the active custom agent; no fixed catalog and no authority expansion
capability_mapping.derived-output-write: Rhapsodia Workspace: derived-only edit/execute within .rhapsodia/catalog and .rhapsodia/views; canonical source writes forbidden

limitations: runtime behavior still depends on the selected model and installed skills
orchestration state is session-scoped unless canonical workflow artifacts provide resumable evidence
parallel analyst dispatch depends on host subagent scheduling; serial fallback preserves semantics
the portable workflow-plan validator is not executed by the read-only supervisor profile unless supplied by another validated workflow
perceptual gates require a separate image-capable/human review capability; they are blocked/not-run when the host adapter cannot provide one

capability_mapping.read-only-analysis: custom subagent with explicit read/search tool scope where supported
capability_mapping.adaptive-workflow-planning: optional skill/customization guidance; serial fallback when unavailable
capability_mapping.executable-verification: custom subagent with bounded execute and verification-only edit authority where supported
capability_mapping.supporting-capability-resolution: host-native Agent Skills/customization discovery where available; no fixed catalog and no authority expansion
capability_mapping.derived-output-write: Rhapsodia Workspace: derived-only edit/execute within .rhapsodia/catalog and .rhapsodia/views; canonical source writes forbidden

limitations: the VS Code-specific agents allowlist is an adapter optimization and may be ignored by other Copilot surfaces
this package is validated primarily for VS Code custom-agent discovery
parallel subagent behavior varies by Copilot surface; serial fallback is required when unavailable
portable semantics are reusable but no Cursor-specific adapter is included
portable semantics are reusable but no Claude-specific agent adapter is included
portable semantics are reusable but no Codex-specific agent adapter is included
the package does not claim runtime parity with VS Code without host-specific validation
portable Agent Skills can carry the reusable capabilities; this package does not claim the VS Code .agent.md discovery format is native to ChatGPT/OpenAI surfaces
translate the portable agent-system contract to native host capabilities without changing authority or gate semantics
